def parse_date(date_str):
    """Parse date string to datetime object"""
    # Handle different date formats
    date_str = date_str.strip()
    
    # Try different formats
    formats = [
        "%d %b %Y",  # 5 Jan 2023
        "%d-%m-%Y",  # 2022-02-29
        "%m/%d/%Y",  # 1/5/2023
    ]
    
    for fmt in formats:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None
